en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from one of our companions, from Jameel, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Whenever it is the morning of Al-Fitr, a Caller calls out: ‘Go to your awards!’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from certain individuals of our people from Jamil ibn Salih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
when it is the morning of the day of al-Fitr, an announcer announces, ‘Come to receive your presents.’”
